LEG_1_primary_delta.why: The PB+TK problem-language/token gap the baseline scores 0 on is 47/77 of the set; recovering ~40% of the headroom is a clearly-not-noise win.

LEG_2_design_works_floor.why: Establishes the new path surfaces a majority of what is reachable, not merely that it beats a matcher that is near-zero off its own idiom.

LEG_3_distribution_wins.rule: engine covered@10 >= baseline covered@10 on >= 35 of 40 problems
LEG_3_distribution_wins.why: Guards against a win concentrated in a few problems AND against regressing the 12 PA problems the matcher already covers. Because PA is already maxed, the LEG_1 delta can only be earned in PB/TK/CE -- the win is forced to land in the target classes.

baseline_snapshot.not_a_strawman: PA (rule-prose) baseline = 27/27 = 1.0; the matcher answers its own idiom perfectly.

ceilings_for_interpretation.engine_content_ceiling: ~1.0 of the 77 E-golds: every E-gold's acceptable_ids are real patterns reachable by a full-canon signal index (not bounded by the 107/179 rule wiring).

is_the_bar_for: S1 engine (Shape-C signal-index port). S0 sets this bar; it does not run the engine.
re_freeze: On corpus/benchmark drift (any pinned hash changes) re-freeze v1->v2; the v1 E-set must stay covered@10 by the engine (eviction FAILS).
set_after: baseline_matcher_pinned.json (legs calibrated from the measured baseline, never before)
verdict_rule: PASS = LEG_1 AND LEG_2 AND LEG_3. Any one failing = NOT a pass; return to council.
